_note: Drives the three Resource Hub sub-pages. Shanelle's structure decisions, 2026-09-01. To add a resource, add an entry to the right list and run `python build.py` - no template or CSS change needed. An entry with an empty `url` renders as a name and description with a 'link coming' marker rather than a dead link, which is the agreed treatment while content arrives over time. Never invent a URL: leave it empty until Legacy supplies it.

trusted_organizations.title: Organizations we refer to
trusted_organizations.blurb: The organizations Legacy regularly points caregivers toward. We know these teams and we trust them with the families we serve.

items.name: Milwaukee County ADRC
items.note: The county's Aging & Disability Resource Center — the usual first call for benefits, assessments and county services.

items.name: Wisconsin Alzheimer's Institute
items.note: Statewide research and education, including dementia-capable care and family programming.

items.name: Alzheimer's Association
items.note: 24/7 helpline, support groups, care navigation and education.

items.name: Lorenzo's House
items.note: Support built specifically around younger-onset dementia and the families living with it.

items.name: Life Navigators
items.note: Guidance and advocacy for families supporting a loved one with disabilities.

items.name: Senior Oasis
items.note: Community programming and day support for older adults.

items.name: CarePatrol
items.note: Help comparing and choosing senior care options when the time comes.

items.name: St. Ann Center
items.note: Intergenerational day services, including care for adults living with dementia.

caregiver_recommended.title: Our caregivers' trusted resources
caregiver_recommended.blurb: Recommended by the caregivers in our community, not by us. If something helped you, tell us and we will add it here.

follow_and_learn.title: Voices worth following
follow_and_learn.blurb: Dementia and caregiving accounts, online educators and people whose work we think is worth your time.

caregiver_tools.title: Guides, worksheets and checklists
caregiver_tools.blurb: Practical materials made by Legacy — things to print, fill in and bring with you.
